tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: What GramForge is and how it works: describe a business in plain words, get a chat assistant on your own Telegram account, change it by describing changes. Returns the summary, steps and main links.

tools.name: list_use_cases
tools.description: Business types GramForge has ready use cases for (beauty salons, clinics, fitness, tutors, coaches, cafés, online shops, customer support, real estate, repair, events, creators) with what the assistant does for each and a page link.

tools.name: get_use_case
tools.description: Details of one use case: what the assistant does, its features, an example business description and a sign-up link with that example prefilled.

tools.name: match_business
tools.description: Given a short description of a business, returns the closest GramForge use case, what the assistant would do for it, a suggested plan and a sign-up link with the description prefilled so the owner only enters an email.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: GramForge plans (Free, Starter, Pro, Studio) with features and monthly prices in USD and Telegram Stars for the given country; prices are lower in many countries.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Step-by-step guides: booking bot without code, selling digital products for Telegram Stars, accepting payments in a bot, order bot for a café or shop, channel autoposting with AI, what a chat assistant does for a small business.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers to common questions: technical skills needed, where clients talk to the assistant, payments, changes by description, ownership of the assistant and client list, languages, integrations.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_overview, list_guides · Public sink: match_business.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_overview, list_guides · Public sink: match_business

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
